name: GoalTracker
subtitle: Your casual football games, remembered.
description: Goals, assists and a match calendar for your Garmin Forerunner 970.

apps.name: GoalTracker
apps.subtitle: Goals, assists and match days
apps.localizedDescription: Track casual football games with a touch screen inside the standard Garmin Football activity. Review game logs, add notes, browse your calendar and see your totals. Requires the GoalTracker Garmin data field for watch import; manual match logging works independently.

versions.localizedDescription:
GoalTracker 1.2.1 (build 4)

- Sync match history now shows progress, actionable Garmin errors, and a 30-second timeout.
- The updated Garmin field reports queued logs, an empty queue, or an active session.
- Retained offline counters are recovered for review when no recording is active, even if the original reset callback was missed.
- Reopening the iPhone app preserves an already ready watch connection. Last received persists across launches.

Update both the iPhone app and the GoalTracker Garmin data field in place. Display GoalTracker inside Football and keep the iPhone app open for transfer. Confirm received games before counting them in statistics.

Existing match history is preserved. Garmin Connect activity sync remains separate. Twelve Swift and twelve Garmin simulator tests pass; physical-device transfer still needs validation.

GoalTracker 1.2 (build 3)

- Dark mode enabled by default, with Dark / Light / System choices in Settings → Appearance.
- Adaptive green accents for readable contrast in both themes.
- Includes typed playing time, 90-minute / 20:00 defaults, combined month and weekday filters, and expanded statistics from 1.1.
- Existing history is preserved. Update through the same AltStore Classic source.

The Garmin private beta uses the simplified two-card counter. Final Garmin store submission remains pending contact-email and developer-terms approval.

GoalTracker 1.1 (build 2)

- Faster manual game entry: type minutes with the number pad. New games default to 90 minutes and 20:00 on the selected day.
- Filter statistics by weekday and month together with year/all-years.
- Added assists and contributions per game, per-90 rates, average playing time, scoring/contribution consistency, hat-tricks and best game records.
- Existing match history and Garmin-recorded times are preserved.

10 core tests pass. Physical-watch touch/sync, Garmin Connect summaries and AltStore re-signing still require device validation.
First beta: native Football touch counter, offline watch logs, match calendar and statistics. Physical-device sync and AltStore installation still need validation.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: GoalTracker receives match goals and assists from your paired Garmin watch.
